analyzer.shared.astTransform

Transformations that are performed on the AST of ANGR’s symbolic expressions to normalize their form and ease analysis.

Functions

extract_summed_vals(ast)

Given an addition node, possibly prefixed by a Zero/Sign extension, returns the complete list of addenda (including nested adds).

generate_addition(addenda)

Add together all the addenda in a single expression.

getCmoveAnnotation(ast)

getSignExtAnnotation(ast)

match_sign_ext(ast, addr)

Transform

sign_ext_to_sum(ast, addr)

Transform SignExt(A, n) into (if A[last] == 0 then 0..A else 0xfffff..A)

simplify_conservative(e)

Simplify the expression and, in contrast to claripy.simplify, discard annotations from the expression that are simplified away.

split_conditions(expr, simplify, addr)

Split any AST that contains CMOVEs, SignExtensions and If-Then-Else statements into separate ASTs with an associated condition.

split_if_statements(ast, ast_addr)

Split expressions that contain if-the-else trees in separate asts.

Classes

CmoveAnnotation(addr)

Signals that a symbolic expression comes from a CMOVE-like instruction.

ConditionType(value)

Track which instruction is associated to a given condition.

ConditionalAst(expr, conds)

Ast with a set of constraints associated to it.

SignExtAnnotation(addr)

Signals that a symbolic expression comes from a SignExt.

Exceptions

SplitTooManyNestedIfException

Too many if statements in expr, skipping
